tools.name: search_podcasts
tools.description:
Search uListen's curated podcast catalog for a topic, person, episode or remembered
quote. Use for podcast recommendations, a host/guest's discussion, or comparisons
grounded in podcast evidence; not for a general advice, news or factual question
that only touches a topic sometimes discussed on podc

tools.name: get_transcript_excerpt
tools.description:
Retrieve verbatim speaker-labeled transcript evidence for one catalog episode and
the requested time ranges. Use videoId plus chunks/additionalRanges from search
for exact quotations or surrounding context, not episode discovery. The server
rechecks current catalog eligibility and usable transcript
